operationUnit: Two actual value-returning logical expressions plus complete selected-value and lazy-RHS counter retention.
specification: Dynamic period-four undefined, empty string, accented text and astral text. OR selects payload/fallback; AND retains falsy payload/undefined or evaluates RHS. Four string leaves per iteration retain both values and cumulative RHS call counts.
notes: Full tagged construction, truthiness selection, fallback calls and output retention pipeline. Independent oracle computes selection by case rather than using the operators. Correctness at native O0/O3 versus Node after strict tsc; timing pending, no allocation parity claim.
